## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended Unresolved idempotency and redaction issues remain in the alert pipeline. **Review effort:** Lite **Findings:** 2
Open (2) - [Make the post and save boundary idempotent](#discussion_r711) · New - [Redact credential values unconditionally](#discussion_r712) · New
What changed in this PR Adds summaries and follow-ups for application error alerts. | File | Summary | |---|---| | `api/alerts/summarize.ts` | Handles initial summaries. **Moderate (1 vote):** make the post and save boundary idempotent across retries. | | `api/alerts/follow-up.ts` | Handles follow-ups. **Moderate (1 vote):** make sequence updates idempotent. **Moderate (2 votes):** guard every close transition with the follow-up thread. | | `api/alerts/redact.ts` | Redacts sensitive values. **Moderate (2 votes):** redact credential values after every auth scheme. | | `api/alerts/state.ts` | Stores incident state. |
